herdr-custom-path-required: Enter the full path of the HERDR executable.
herdr-custom-path-not-executable: The custom HERDR path can't be run. Check that the file exists and is executable, or switch back to the bundled version.
herdr-custom-path-not-exe: On Windows the custom path must point to herdr.exe.
herdr-path-binary-not-found: HERDR was not found on PATH. Install it, choose a custom path, or use the bundled version.
herdr-not-found-on-path: HERDR was not found on PATH. Install it, choose a custom path, or use the bundled version.
herdr-binary-unavailable: No usable HERDR binary was found for startup. Use the bundled version or fix the custom path in Settings > HERDR.
herdr-config-dir-not-configured: The HERDR config directory is not set up yet. Restart Yuzora and try again.
host-artifacts-not-bundled: This Yuzora build doesn't include tools for that host. Install a full release build.
host-artifact-missing: A bundled host tool file is missing. Reinstall Yuzora.
host-artifact-unavailable: The host tool for this platform isn't available. Reinstall Yuzora or pick another host.
host-artifact-hash-mismatch: A host tool file failed its integrity check. Reinstall Yuzora.
host-artifact-version-mismatch: The host tool version doesn't match this Yuzora. Update the host tools in Settings > HERDR.
herdr-artifact-version-mismatch: The bundled HERDR version doesn't match what this Yuzora expects. Reinstall Yuzora.
invalid-host-artifact: The host tool package is invalid. Reinstall Yuzora.
invalid-host-artifact-path: The host tool path is invalid. Reinstall Yuzora.
invalid-artifact-hash: The host tool checksum is malformed. Reinstall Yuzora.
host-helper-unavailable: The host helper isn't available. Run Check in Settings > HERDR to deploy it.
invalid-helper-path: The helper path on the host is invalid. Run Check again to redeploy it.
host-probe-not-utf8: The host returned unreadable output while being probed.
host-probe-output-too-large: The host's probe output was too large. Check the shell startup files on that host.
invalid-host-probe: The host returned an unexpected probe result.
host-home-unavailable: Couldn't determine the home directory on the host.
host-setup-command-failed: A setup command on the host failed. Open diagnostics for details.
host-setup-timeout: Setting up the host timed out. Check the connection and try again.
host-manifest-too-large: The host manifest is too large to read.
host-disconnected: The host is disconnected. Reconnect and try again.
host-request-timeout: The host took too long to respond. Check the connection and try again.
host-request-limit: The host is busy with too many requests. Try again shortly.
host-request-wait-timeout: The host stayed busy and the request timed out. Try again shortly.
host-call-limit: The host is busy with too many calls. Try again shortly.
host-call-wait-timeout: The host stayed busy and the call timed out. Try again shortly.
host-stream-closed: The host stream closed unexpectedly. Reconnect and try again.
host-stream-ended: The host stream ended. Reconnect and try again.
host-stream-missing: The host stream is no longer available. Reconnect and try again.
host-stream-open-wait-timeout: The host is too busy to open another stream. Try again shortly.
host-manager-shutting-down: Yuzora is shutting down its host connections.
host-response-identity-mismatch: The host replied for a different connection and the reply was discarded. Try again.
runtime-incompatible: This HERDR client is incompatible with the running Sessions. Choose a compatible client; Yuzora won't stop your Sessions.
herdr-session-incompatible: The Session's HERDR server doesn't support this action. Update or restart that Session's HERDR.
herdr-unavailable: HERDR is unavailable. Check the HERDR source in Settings > HERDR.
herdr-not-found-on-selected-host: HERDR was not found on the selected host. Install it there or pick the managed version.
herdr-not-executable-on-selected-host: The HERDR file on the selected host isn't executable. Fix its permissions or path.
herdr-host-path-must-be-absolute: Use an absolute path inside the selected host.
herdr-socket-unavailable: Can't reach the HERDR server socket. Make sure the Session is running.
herdr-socket-timeout: The HERDR server didn't respond in time.
herdr-socket-closed: The HERDR server closed the connection.
herdr-operation-error: HERDR rejected the operation. Open diagnostics for its message.
herdr-session-start-failed: The HERDR Session failed to start. Open diagnostics for details.
herdr-session-start-timeout: The HERDR Session took too long to start.
herdr-command-failed: The HERDR command failed. Open diagnostics for details.
invalid-runtime-file: A HERDR runtime file is invalid.
invalid-herdr-output: HERDR printed output Yuzora couldn't understand. Check the HERDR version.
herdr-invalid-json: HERDR returned invalid JSON. Check the HERDR version.
runtime-preferences-unwritable: Yuzora could not save the runtime preference. Check that its app data folder is writable.
wsl-runtime-disabled-open-settings: WSL is turned off. Enable it in Settings > HERDR.
wsl-requires-windows: WSL is only available on Windows.
wsl-discovery-failed: Couldn't list WSL distributions. Make sure WSL 2 is installed.
wsl-discovery-timeout: Listing WSL distributions timed out. Try again.
wsl-identity-changed-or-not-wsl2: The WSL distribution changed or is not WSL 2. Select it again.
wsl-path-conversion-failed: Couldn't convert the path between Windows and WSL.
invalid-wsl-distro: The WSL distribution name is invalid.
native-client-limit: Too many HERDR clients are open. Close one and try again.
native-client-requires-compatible-sessio: That Session isn't compatible with this HERDR client. Check the runtime in Settings > HERDR.
native-client-exit-timeout: The HERDR client didn't exit in time.
native-client-must-run-on-owning-host: The HERDR client must run on the host that owns the Session.
